verdict.rationale: Bevy's own docs claim 0.8-3.0 second iterative compiles with its "fast compiles" configuration, and hot reload without restarts or recompiles. However, hot reload is documented only for scenes, textures, and meshes, not for game logic. Since logic is Rust code, a code change still needs a recompile, so the loop is fast but not true code hot reload. Missing for 10: hot reload of game logic/code changes, independent or hands-on corroboration of the compile-time claims, and detail on what the fast-compiles setup requires.

support.subject: As a game developer, the edit-run loop is fast — hot reload or near-instant preview after a script change

citations.quote: With Bevy you can expect 0.8-3.0 seconds with the "fast compiles" configuration
Get instant feedback on your changes without app restarts or recompiles
You can currently hot-reload scenes, textures, and meshes
